method: Product-area searches across Fortinet Community/KB; opened candidate articles to inspect original publication/update timestamps and technical content. Only verified dates in the window are counted as recent; older items and search-index false positives are excluded.

findings.title: Administrator SSO authentication fails after upgrade to FortiOS 7.6.8
findings.scenario: Admin SSO-only WEB_AUTH/FORTISM Violation; VPN user SSO and local/remote admin auth not affected.

findings.title: FortiGate enters conserve mode after FortiOS 7.6.8 with IPS Engine 7.01200
findings.scenario: IPS engine regression resolved by IPS Engine 7.01204; diagnose autoupdate downgrade workaround.

findings.title: Admin GUI logs out immediately after successful login on FortiOS 7.6.7
findings.scenario: HTTPS GUI resource burst mistaken for attack; auth can succeed before session is cut.

findings.title: Policy Package install verification mismatch for antiphish max-body-len
findings.scenario: FortiProxy default changed 65535 to 1024; FortiManager retained 65535; optimal verification workaround.

findings.title: LDAPS configuration erased after FortiManager upgrade
findings.scenario: RADIUS/TACACS+ remote auth configs also require a valid CA certificate.

findings.title: Upgrade firmware fails with New image is too big
findings.scenario: FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager 8.0 VM flash disk minimum 4 GB; verify diagnose system flash list and expand disk.

findings.title: EAP authentication failed due to missing token with EAP-TTLS/PAP and 2FA
